notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Program.Taxi.cs covers the session and the window: eligibility/distance gating, CMSG_TAXINODE_STATUS_QUERY, CMSG_TAXIQUERYNODES, SMSG_SHOWTAXINODES decode (mask -> known nodes), the 384x512 UI-TaxiFrame four-piece shell, the continent TAXIMAP texture in the 316x352 rect, node icons projected from TaxiNodes.dbc, click-to-fly (CMSG_ACTIVATETAXI), name/You-are-here tooltip, SMSG_ACTIVATETAXIREPLY, flight spline playback with input lockout and arrival hand-off, flight-master title text. Concrete Benilla/ref behaviors are absent.
